notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Changelog
notes.notes:
With this update we hope to fix the most common crash we saw, which is an out of VRAM error. We completely reworked the way how we store the ingame textures, reducing the overall size of the game by almost 2 GB and reducing the overall VRAM usage heavily as well. Also, most rendered objects now require about 30% less texture lookups, which may result in some performance gains depending on your system.

[hr][/hr]

 Repacked most of the ingame textures

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Changed opponent paint job on European Forest 5 & American Desert 3
 Fixed SteamVR overlay making the game unresponsive in some cases
 Fixed bridges loading the wrong model
 Fixed controller switch track button not resetting when releasing controller
 Fixed cars not stopping when releasing controller at low throttle
 Fixed long black screen when launching the game
 Fixed several small internal issues

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused workshop maps to always load in the cellar

IMPORTANT: If you have a map uploaded to the workshop, this will not repair it, unfortunately. You'll need to reupload it for this to be fixed.

[hr][/hr]
 Fixed a bug that caused other players to be able to pick up your car while driving
 Fixed ingame music volume not applying until restarting the game
 Fixed several small internal issues

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Changelog
notes.notes: Fixed an issue introduced with 1.0.1 that caused the page buttons on the object table to not work

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Changelog
notes.notes:
Added automatic crash reporting - this should help us identify and fix crashes and other bugs in the game
 Added race cancel button for campaign - this is currently campaign exclusive but will be ported to single- and multiplayer in the future
 Changed the controller power curve
 Fixed an issue that sometimes the main menu was more transparent than it should be
 Fixed some odd hitbox behavior

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=MrDN2hygIiA;full][/previewyoutube]

Slotracers VR will release on March 4th for a price of $24.99 with a 10% launch discount. Regional pricing will apply, so the price may vary depending on your location.

Updated System Requirements
The system requirements previously stated on our storepage we're an estimate. However, the game has become much more demanding than we expected, so we needed to increase them. The new requirements are as follows:

Minimum
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10
Processor: Intel Core i5-6600k or equivalent AMD Ryzen
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 or equivalent AMD card (8 GB VRAM recommended)
DirectX: Version 11
Sound Card: Any sound card

Broadband internet connection recommended for online multiplayer.

Recommended
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10
Processor: Intel Core i5-7600k or equivalent AMD Ryzen
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2080 or equivalent AMD card
DirectX: Version 11
Sound Card: Any sound card

Broadband internet connection recommended for online multiplayer.


Regarding Linux support
In the past we've advertised the game as having a native Linux version. Unfortunately, we need to cancel the version as a result of a recent engine upgrade where Linux support has been dropped by the engine. We've hoped that support would be added back quickly, however this didn't occur yet.

We've extensively tested the game with Proton and can confirm that the game is working perfectly fine with it. We'll look out for opportunities to restore the Linux version and will release it in the future if we can.
